# Nominjin Tsogtbayar (NOMI)

> 3rd-year Information Technology student at MUST-SICT (Mongolian University of Science and Technology) and Software Engineering Intern at erxes Mongolia. Builds LLM-powered agents, full-stack web apps, and practices offensive security on HackTheBox. Based in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. Available for work.

## Focus
- Agentic tools: LLM agents with LangChain and custom tools; exploring MCP servers and agentic developer loops
- Full-stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Django, Docker, Linux
- Security: HackTheBox machines — enumeration, privilege escalation, custom payloads

## Experience
- Software Engineering Intern, erxes Mongolia (2026 – present): full-stack and automation work on a source-available Experience OS — https://erxes.io
- BSc Information Technology (in progress), MUST, School of Information and Communication Technology

## Projects
- [Profile Art Engine](https://github.com/NOMINJIN3/NOMINJIN3): automated GitHub profile artwork — ASCII portrait and contribution heatmap regenerated daily via GitHub Actions
